headline: Magic keyboard in English, name cleanup, less ROM bloat
summary: Major polish round. The ARM9 + UI overlay menu pools are translated for the first time (this is the release that introduced the menu code path v2.31 had to fix the compressed-flag for), 401 dialog-overflow rewrites land, currency unified to "Ritch" everywhere, NPCs have consistent names, and the patched-ROM size drops ~1.57 MB from a build-side dedup fix. This is the largest content drop before the v2.31 stabilization.
